# GPTShopExpert

> GPTShopExpert is a remote-first GEO & AEO agency. We get businesses found, trusted, and cited by AI engines — ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, and Bing Copilot — through citation audits, structured data, llms.txt, content, and GEO-ready websites.

GPTShopExpert specializes in Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): the practice of structuring a business's website and content so AI systems can discover, understand, quote, and recommend it. We serve businesses that want to grow through AI search, and agencies that need a white-label GEO partner for their clients.

## Services

- [AI Citation Audit](https://gptshopexpert.com/#services): A full GEO + AEO audit with a scored 0–100 report and prioritized fix plan — citability and schema analysis, AI crawler and llms.txt access checks, and platform readiness for ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. Delivered in 5 days. From $1.5k.
- [GEO-Ready Websites](https://gptshopexpert.com/#services): A fast, server-rendered website engineered to be found and cited by AI from day one — entity and keyword mapping, full schema markup, llms.txt and crawler access, and answer-first content. 4–8 weeks. From $12k.
- [Ongoing GEO Management](https://gptshopexpert.com/#services): Monthly optimization and content, citation and share-of-voice tracking, schema and technical upkeep, and white-label client reporting. From $3k/mo.

## Capabilities

- AI citability (answer blocks, quotability, passage extraction)
- Technical SEO (crawlability, indexing, Core Web Vitals)
- Schema & structured data (JSON-LD, Schema.org, rich results)
- llms.txt & AI crawler access (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended)
- Content & E-E-A-T (experience, expertise, authoritativeness, trust)
- Brand authority (web mentions, entity recognition, sameAs)
- Platform optimization (Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Bing Copilot)
- GEO audits (scored reports and roadmaps)
- Citation monitoring (tracking, share of voice, alerts)
- GEO-ready websites (Next.js, server-side rendering, schema)
- Answer-first content (Q&A, FAQ, sourced and quotable copy)
- Agency white-label (reseller GEO services and reporting)

## Process

1. Audit — score the site's GEO/AEO and pinpoint why AI isn't citing it yet.
2. Optimize — fix schema, llms.txt, content structure, and crawler access.
3. Build — where needed, ship a fast server-rendered site engineered to be cited.
4. Monitor — track citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews, then iterate.
